messages:
maria: quick check — running into a weird behavior in the JS SDK around streaming + retries when users set disableClientMetrics: true. on the retry the User-Agent header disappears and tracestate sometimes shows the same redwood entry twice. has anyone hit this?

kevin: are you on node or browser? also which fetch implementation? short repro would help. :thinking:

maria: node (serverless lambda). using our wrapper around fetch with a retry loop. minimal repro: 
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey, disableClientMetrics: true });
await client.streamChat({ model: 'redwood-large', prompt: 'hi' });
// if connection resets we retry; second attempt lacks UA header
```

david: likely we rebuild the Request each retry but reuse the same Headers object which some libs mutate/consume. in the old retry code we did: 
```
const req = new Request(url, { headers: defaultHeaders });
for (...) await fetch(req);
```
Request/Headers can be mutated/consumed across attempts. try cloning headers per retry: `new Headers(defaultHeaders)`

maria: cloning fixed the UA loss. still seeing tracestate dupes though (redwood entry repeated).

ashley: tracestate duplication often happens when both the SDK and the app add entries. our code appends `redwood=...` naively. on retry we re-append. we should detect an existing `redwood=` and replace it instead of concatenating. also when disableClientMetrics is true we must not emit `x-redwood-client-metrics` ever — looks like legacy path still adds it during retries.

kevin: yep. utility could be `mergeTracestate(existing, ours)` that splits on comma, filters out existing `redwood=` entries, and then joins with ours at the front. also ensure trimming to avoid accidental empty segments.

maria: current observed header on second try: 
```
traceparent: 00-abcdef0123456789-01
tracestate: redwood=abc,redwood=abc
```

dash: @maria can you add a unit that simulates a retry and asserts: UA present, tracestate contains one `redwood=` only, and `x-redwood-client-metrics` is not present when disableClientMetrics=true? would be great to also add a small integration covering serverless env since mutation seems platform-specific.

maria: yes I'll add tests. plan: fix header cloning, add `mergeTracestate`, ensure metrics header is removed when flag set, add unit + lambda-like integration test. will open draft PR and ping for review.

david: code pointers: 
- clone headers per retry: `const hdrs = new Headers(origHeaders)`
- strip metrics: `if (options.disableClientMetrics) hdrs.delete('x-redwood-client-metrics')`
- tracestate: `hdrs.set('tracestate', mergeTracestate(hdrs.get('tracestate'), ourEntry))`

kevin: small nit: document why we clone headers and call out fetch/Request behavior in a code comment. we've tripped on this before.

maria: opened draft PR 4821 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/client-js/pull/4821. includes tests + changelog note.

telemetry-bot: ci: client-js-telemetry-tests passed on branch maria/ja-trace-fix :white_check_mark:

kevin: nice. will review shortly. once merged, @ashley can you add a short blurb to release notes about tracing dedupe and `disableClientMetrics` semantics?

ashley: will do. thanks all — closing thread after merge. :rocket:
